content.short: GASSSS is a gas-sponsored execution protocol letting users interact with DeFi without paying gas upfront.
content.description: GASSSS sponsors gas so users can interact with DeFi protocols without first holding a native token to pay fees, building on EIP-7702 account behaviour. On Stable it runs a sponsored stable swap. The first-transaction problem, where a new user has assets but no gas, is one of the more persistent onboarding frictions, and sponsorship is one of the cleaner fixes.
content.meta: GASSSS is a gas-sponsored execution protocol for DeFi without upfront gas fees, running on Stable.
